patterns.note: A dark mode interface with a very dark background and high-contrast white text, using vibrant, multi-color gradients as primary visual accents.
Content is centered within a defined maximum width, providing generous horizontal padding on larger screens for readability.
Prominent, large, bold sans-serif headings are used to introduce each major section, establishing a clear content hierarchy.
Dynamic, multi-color gradients are a signature visual element, prominently featured in the hero and as subtle background details.
A sticky navigation bar transforms from transparent over the hero to a solid dark background and slightly reduced height upon scrolling down the page.
The hero section features a dynamic, colorful gradient element that appears to parallax or remain fixed in the background as the page content scrolls over it.
Code snippets and terminal-like interfaces are integrated as visual examples within feature sections, reinforcing the product's technical nature.

technique_notes: Implement a global dark theme using a very dark background color for the page and sections, paired with high-contrast white for primary text and lighter gray for secondary information and links.

Create a sticky header that initially has a transparent background, then transitions to a solid dark background and a slightly reduced height using CSS transitions or transforms when the user scrolls past the hero section.

Utilize a video or animated SVG for the hero's vibrant, multi-color gradient element, positioning it with a fixed or parallax effect so that page content scrolls over it while the background element moves at a different rate or remains stationary.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body size) with a clean, modern sans-serif body text for high readability on a dark background.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., 4-8px) on buttons, input fields, and card-like elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a particularly airy hero section.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dynamic, multi-color gradient hero on a deep dark background creates a striking and modern visual identity. This vibrant, almost playful element contrasts effectively with the otherwise clean, high-contrast interface, making the site feel both sophisticated and approachable for a technical product.
